## Contribution

Is this one new signed CRL record, or an infrastructure/governance change?

- [ ] I have authority to disclose and license the material.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or private data.
- [ ] Scientific records preserve references to known relevant objections.
- [ ] Research code is referenced as an artifact, not executed by admission CI.

Protocol admission is not scientific acceptance. Infrastructure changes are never auto-admitted by the record gate.
